description: The bar chart illustrates the effect of context masking on case tasks, grouped by language family. The horizontal axis contains the categories, labeled "family," and displays nine language groups from left to right: IE-Baltic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indic, IE-Romance, IE-Slavic, IE-other, Isolate, Semitic, and Uralic. The vertical value axis is labeled "effect" and uses a linear scale with numeric tick labels at intervals of 10, ranging from 0 to 30, with horizontal grid lines corresponding to these intervals. The chart features grouped vertical bars, where each language family category contains a cluster of six bars representing different models, as indicated by a legend in the top right. The colors represent the following models: light blue for mBERT-L$_2$, dark blue for XLM-L$_2$, light green for mBERT-R$_2$, dark green for XLM-R$_2$, light red for mBERT-B$_2$, and dark red for XLM-B$_2$. The heights of the bars vary across the categories, with the tallest bars appearing in the IE-Indic group, where the dark red bar (XLM-B$_2$) reaches approximately 21. The Semitic group also displays large effects, though its light green bar (mBERT-R$_2$) extends below the zero line to approximately -2. The shortest bars are found in the Isolate and Uralic categories, where all model values remain near zero. The categories are not sorted by bar height, and every bar is visually emphasized with a vertical error bar indicating the standard deviation.
